PlacementNoticeKind.description: What a notice of a pool says about a node. More kinds may come: a match on it needs a wildcard arm.

oneOf.description: The node was not heard from for the silence time: it gets no new places. Sent once per silence.
A silent node offered again and is live.

Another instance offered under the live node's id, whose offers are ignored, or a member reported another
machine under it (`Duplicate`). Sent once while the mark lasts; the node's `conflict` names the instance and,
for a report, the host. Or the node offered a resource key another live node holds, whose offers are ignored:
sent once while its entry in the pool's `contested` lasts, which names the key.

The pool knows `maxNodes` nodes or more and ignored an offer of the node, which it does not know (ADR 0075).
Sent once while the pool's `full` mark lasts, about the first node it ignored then; raise `maxNodes` with
`Configure`, or declare silent nodes `Gone`.

Alert.description:
Sends the alert target a notice about `node`, in a turn of its own so that a failing target fails only this
alert; nothing without a target. Sent by the pool to itself.
Alert.title: Alert

Alerts.description: Sets where the pool's notices go, replacing the target before.

messageType.description:
The message type of the notices, whose payload is a [`PlacementNotice`]; not empty, at most 200 characters,
without NUL.

Alerts.title: Alerts

Ask.description:
Asks a place for `holder` on a node with every one of `needs` (sorted, each once), and names where its answer
goes. It is granted on the live node with a free place and every need that has the most free places, ties to
the smaller node id; queued when only silent or full nodes have the needs, or the pool holds `maxHolders` or
more; refused with `noNode` when no node of the pool has them, `lineFull` when it must wait and the line holds
`maxWaiting` asks or more, and `poolFull` when a place fits but the pool holds `maxHolders` or more and the line
is full. The [`PlacementAnswer`] goes to the target in this commit, so a target that is gone fails the ask and
nothing is recorded. A repeated `Ask` of a holder answers `granted` with the same grant and node, one of a
waiting ask `queued`; both keep the first ask's needs and target. A holder id is forgotten at its release: use a
fresh one per attempt. The pool watches the target from the commit that records the ask, and when it is deleted
frees its places and takes its waiting asks out of the line; an ask whose target is the pool itself is refused
for good.

holder.description: The holder: names this attempt, unique among the holders and waiting asks of the pool.

messageType.description:
The message type of the answer, whose payload is a [`PlacementAnswer`]; not empty, at most 200 characters,
without NUL.

needs.description: The labels a node must have: at most 32, each 1 through 100 characters without NUL.

Ask.title: Ask

Cancel.description: Takes a waiting ask out of the line; ignored for a holder, which releases with its grant number instead.

holder.description: The holder of the waiting ask.

Cancel.title: Cancel

Check.description:
The silence timer: sent by the pool to itself, and counted only when it is the armed one (`armedId`). Marks each
live node not heard from for the silence time as silent, queues an `Alert` for each, removes each contest and
the `full` mark one silence time after its last offer, and arms the next check at the earliest end of a live
node's silence, of a contest or of the `full` mark, or clears `armed` when none is left. Run early (made due by
an operator) it arms itself again at `armed`;
any other `Check` the pool sent itself changes nothing, and one from another sender is refused for good.
Check.title: Check

Configure.description:
Changes the pool's settings, from anyone: each field set replaces its value, each absent one keeps it, within
the bounds of [`PlacementState::new`]. A limit below what the pool has removes nothing: the nodes, holders,
waiting asks and contests stay, and new ones are ignored, refused or queued until the count is below it. A
larger `maxHolders` grants waiting asks in this turn. A silence other than the current one, with a check armed,
arms the check at the new earliest end of a live node's silence, of a contest or of the `full` mark, at once
when that has passed, so a shorter one marks the quiet nodes silent in the next turn. Refused for good with the
state unchanged when no field is set, a value is out of bounds, or the silence of a node, a contest or the
`full` mark would end after the last representable instant. Unknown fields are ignored, as in every message of
the pool, so a misspelled field next to a valid one changes nothing.

maxHolders.description: The most holders of the pool at once, 1 through 1,000. Absent: kept.

maxNodes.description: The most nodes the pool knows, 1 through 1,000. Absent: kept.

maxWaiting.description: The most asks that wait in the line, 0 through 1,000. Absent: kept.

silence.description:
How long a node may go without an offer before it is silent, as an ISO-8601 duration; 1 second through 1
day. Keep it above the members' offer interval. Absent: kept.

Configure.title: Configure

Drain.description:
Stops new places on `node`: it keeps its holders, renews its offers and can go silent and come back, and an
offer does not clear the drain. Draining a draining node changes nothing; an unknown node is refused for good.
Drain.title: Drain

Duplicate.description:
A report, from anyone, such as a [`PlacementMember`] that found another host name in its node's row: another
machine, `host`, runs under the id of `node` (ADR 0071). For a live node it marks the node in `conflict` with
`host`, the node's own instance unless another instance marked it already, and the store time; a new mark is
told `conflict`. The node gets no new places while the mark has a `host`, which ends one silence time after the
last report (a mark set by an offer too ends as an offer's would, so when both would). Nothing for a silent
node, which gets no new places anyway; refused for good for an unknown node.

host.description: The host name of the other machine, as the node table shows it.

node.description: The node id the other machine runs under.

Duplicate.title: Duplicate

Failed.description:
The notification of a message to a watched actor that ended `failed`: what the failed message was and why it
failed. Its type name is `Failed`. A watcher's message family declares it as `Failed(cicada::Failed)`.

Its schema is part of every watcher's contract; a snapshot test pins it.

actor.description: The actor the failed message was for: the actor of the event, not the target of the watch.

attempts.description: How often the message was claimed: its `attempt`.

oneOf.description:
The handler returned an error or panicked, and no retry is left; or it returned a new state that cannot be
stored.

The node or the store failed around the turn: a read the node needed failed, also one the handler passed on,
or a panic outside the handler.
The handler refused the message for good (a permanent failure).
The turn ran past its maximum duration.
The state or the address of the actor cannot be read by its type.
The effects of the turn were refused, or its commit was rejected or refused.
The message reached the claim limit (ADR 0025).

correlationId.description: The correlation id of the failed message; null when it has none.

from.description: The sender of the failed message; null for a message sent from outside a turn.

messageId.description: The id of the failed message.

messageType.description: The type name of the failed message.

payload.description: The payload of the failed message.

Failed.title: Failed

Gone.description:
Declares a silent node gone: removes it, frees all its places and tells each of its holders with a `gone`
answer, each in a turn of its own. Refused for good for a live node (it is heard from) and an unknown one. A
later `Release` of those grants frees nothing; the node offering again is a new node.
Gone.title: Gone

Notify.description:
Sends `holder` its `granted` answer when it still holds a place, and marks it as told; nothing otherwise. Sent
by the pool to itself for a grant from the line, in a turn of its own, with a retry policy.
Notify.title: Notify

Offer.description:
A node offers its places: replaces the node's entry with this instance, these labels (sorted, each once),
places and resource key, heard at the store time of this turn, and live. A silent node that offers is told
`back` to the alert target, whatever its instance. An offer of another instance than the recorded one while the
node is live changes no entry field: it marks the node in `conflict`, and a new mark is told `conflict`. An
offer of a resource key that another live node holds changes nothing for the node: it is recorded in
`contested`, and a new entry there is told `conflict` (ADR 0072). An offer of a node new to a pool that knows
`maxNodes` nodes or more changes no entry: it sets or moves the pool's `full` mark, and a new mark is told
`full` (ADR 0075). A new contest in a pool that lists `maxNodes` or more is refused for good. Send one at an
interval shorter than the silence time.

instance.description:
An id that tells two machines offering under one node id apart, kept across restarts, such as
`NodeIdentity::instance`. One drawn at each process start makes a restart within the silence time look
like a second machine.

labels.description: What the node offers, such as its processor kind: at most 32, each 1 through 100 characters without NUL.

node.description: The node id the member's node pins its actors under.

places.description: How many places the node offers, 0 through 1,000; 0 keeps the node known but full.

resource.description:
The resource whose places these are, such as the Docker daemon's id (`RuntimeInfo::id` of
`cicada-containers`): 1 through 200 characters without NUL. One live node holds a key (ADR 0072). Absent:
none.

Offer.title: Offer

Rearm.description:
Cancels the armed check and arms a new one at its unchanged time, at once when that has passed: the recovery of
a check that was purged, cancelled or failed for good. Nothing when no node is live, no contest is listed and
the pool is not marked `full`.
Rearm.title: Rearm

Release.description:
Frees the place of `holder` when it holds `grant`; ignored otherwise, so a late release of an older grant frees
nothing.
Release.title: Release

Stopped.description:
The notification of a watched actor that went away. Its type name is `Stopped`. A watcher's message family declares
it as `Stopped(cicada::Stopped)`. Only a watch on the actor's own address tells of it.

Its schema is part of every watcher's contract; a snapshot test pins it.

by.description:
The actor whose turn removed it: the actor itself when it stopped, the stopping ancestor when it went with it;
null for a removal from outside a turn.

oneOf.description: It was deleted from outside a turn.
It was removed with its parent (ADR 0019).

Stopped.title: Stopped

TellGone.description:
Sends `holder` its `gone` answer for `grant` on `node`, to `to` as `messageType`: sent by the pool to itself for
each holder of a node declared gone, with a retry policy, so a failing target fails only its own answer.

messageType.description: The message type of its answers; not empty, at most 200 characters, without NUL.

TellGone.title: TellGone

Undrain.description:
Gives `node` new places again and grants the waiting asks that fit. Undraining a node that is not draining
changes nothing; an unknown node is refused for good.
Undrain.title: Undrain

PlacementAlerts.description: Where the notices of a pool go.

messageType.description: The message type of the notices; not empty, at most 200 characters, without NUL.

PlacementAsk.description: An ask waiting in the line of a pool.

holder.description: The holder; 1 through 200 characters without NUL.

messageType.description: The message type of its answers; not empty, at most 200 characters, without NUL.

needs.description: The labels a node must have, sorted, each once; at most 32, each 1 through 100 characters without NUL.

PlacementConflict.description:
An offer of another instance under a live node's id, which the pool ignored, or a report of another machine under
it (`Duplicate`, ADR 0071).

at.description: The store time of the last conflicting offer or report.

host.description:
The host name of the other machine of the last report; set once a report marked the node, and the node gets no
new places while it is. 1 through 200 characters, not blank, without NUL. Absent: no report.

instance.description:
The other instance id: not the node's recorded one, except for a mark set only by reports, which names the
node's own; 1 through 200 characters, not blank, without NUL.

PlacementContest.description:
An offer of a resource key that another live node held, which the pool ignored (ADR 0072): one per key and
offering node, kept for one silence time after the last such offer.

at.description: The store time of its last offer of the key while another live node held it.

node.description:
The node that offered it; 1 through 200 characters, not blank, without NUL. It may be one the pool does not
know.

resource.description: The resource key; 1 through 200 characters without NUL.

PlacementFull.description:
The mark of a full pool (ADR 0075): an offer of a node the pool did not know, ignored because the pool knew
`maxNodes` nodes or more. One per pool, kept for one silence time after the last such offer, or until an offer adds
a node.

at.description: The store time of the last ignored offer.

node.description: The node of the last ignored offer; 1 through 200 characters, not blank, without NUL.

PlacementHolder.description: A holder of a place on a node of a pool.

grant.description: Its grant number: at least 1, below the pool's `nextGrant`.

holder.description: The holder; 1 through 200 characters without NUL.

messageType.description: The message type of its answers; not empty, at most 200 characters, without NUL.

needs.description: The needs of its ask, sorted, each once; at most 32, each 1 through 100 characters without NUL.

node.description: The node id of its place: a node the pool knows.

notified.description: True once a `granted` answer to it committed; while false, a failed `Notify` frees the place.

PlacementNode.description: What a pool knows of a node: its last offer and whether it is heard from.

conflict.description:
The last offer of another instance, ignored, or the last report of another machine, while it was live; set only
while it is live. Absent: none.

draining.description: Whether an operator drained it: it gets no new places until `Undrain`. Absent: false.

heardAt.description: The store time of the turn of its last offer.

instance.description: The instance id of its last offer; 1 through 200 characters, not blank, without NUL.

labels.description: The labels of its last offer, sorted, each once; at most 32, each 1 through 100 characters without NUL.

places.description: The places of its last offer, 0 through 1,000.

resource.description:
The resource key of its last offer; 1 through 200 characters without NUL. While it is live no other live node
has this key. Absent: none.

PlacementNodeStatus.description: Whether a node of a pool is heard from.

oneOf.description: Heard from within the silence time.
Not heard from for the silence time: it gets no new places until it offers again.

state.description:
The state of a [`Placement`] pool: its silence time, node limit, line limit and holder limit, given at its create
and changed by `Configure`, where its notices go, the nodes it knows by node id, the next grant number, its holders
in the order they were granted, its waiting asks in line order, the contests of resource keys, the `full` mark, and
the time and id of its armed check.
Build it with `PlacementState::new`; a decoded state is checked the same way.

On the wire: `{"silence":"PT1M","maxNodes":1000,"maxWaiting":100,"maxHolders":1000,"alerts":null,"nodes":{},
"nextGrant":1,"holders":[],"waiting":[],"contested":[],"armed":null,"armedId":null}`; `full` is written only while
it is set, and `alerts`, `nodes`, `nextGrant`, `holders`, `waiting`, `contested`, `full`, `armed` and `armedId` may
be left out of a create.

alerts.description: Where its notices go; absent or null: no notices.

armed.description: The time of the armed `Check`: present exactly while a node is live, a contest is listed or `full` is set.

armedId.description: The id of the armed `Check`: present exactly with `armed`.

contested.description:
The offers of resource keys that another live node held, at most 1,000 (more than `maxNodes` after a lower
limit), each key and node once; absent: none.

full.description:
The last offer of a new node ignored because the pool knew `maxNodes` nodes or more, kept for one silence time
after its `at` or until an offer adds a node; absent or null: none.

holders.description:
The holders, in the order they were granted, at most 1,000 (more than `maxHolders` after a lower limit), each on
a known node, each holder id once among the holders and waiting asks; absent: none.

maxHolders.description: The most holders of the pool at once; 1 through 1000.

maxNodes.description: The most nodes the pool knows; 1 through 1000.

maxWaiting.description: The most asks that wait in the line; 0 through 1000.

nextGrant.description: The number of the next grant, at least 1; it only goes up. Absent: 1.

nodes.description:
The nodes it knows, by node id (1 through 200 characters, not blank, without NUL), at most 1,000 (more than
`maxNodes` after a lower limit); absent: none.

silence.description: How long a node may go without an offer before it is silent, as an ISO-8601 duration; 1 second through 1 day.

waiting.description:
The waiting asks, in line order, at most 1,000 (more than `maxWaiting` after a lower limit), each holder id once
among the holders and waiting asks; absent: none.

state.title: PlacementState
